question: What monitoring frequencies do opaque LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE values (e.g. 05/WK, 01/07, 01/01) establish?

judgment.semantic_question_used: What monitoring frequency does limit_freq_of_analysis_code '01/07' require for this permit limit row (pH maximum, permit NM0028762, Outfall 001, DISCHARGE BACKWASH WATER)?
judgment.interpretation: Monitoring is required once per week (weekly), conditioned on discharge occurring ('when discharging'). The permit's Part I effluent limits table for pH at Outfall 001 specifies measurement frequency '1/Week (*1)' with footnote '*1 When discharging,' matching this row's DMR comment 'WHEN DISCHARGING.'
judgment.grounding: Permit NM0028762 final permit Part I, Section A lists pH (STORET code 00400) with minimum 6.6 and maximum 9.0 standard units, measurement frequency '1/Week (*1)', sample type Grab; footnote *1 states 'When discharging.' The statement of basis for the same permit confirms 'pH shall continue to be monitored weekly when discharging.' This row is the maximum pH limit (9.0 SU, statistical base MAX) for parameter 00400 at Outfall 001 under limit set DISCHARGE BACKWASH WATER.

judgment.remaining_uncertainty: The workspace contains no explicit ICIS-NPDES code legend defining the literal string '01/07'; resolution links this row to the permit narrative by matching permit number, outfall, parameter, limit values, and discharge condition. Whether discharge actually occurred in any evaluated period is a separate applicability question (conditional_discharge_dependent_monitoring), not part of interpreting the frequency code itself.
